scope: Synthetic local two-tenant V1, HTTP API through PSA simulator; no inference under load
mix: Three context reads then one approved write; alternating tenants; alternating note/time writes
resources: API/simulator/test runner <=384 MiB and 1 CPU each; DB <=256 MiB and 1 CPU; no host ports
stop: Abort profile on first failed outcome; stop isolated stack on failure; never touch unrelated projects
limitations: Short desktop qualification, not sustained production soak or capacity certification. Real-provider timing and quality are separately recorded in Phase 6.
